mods.name: StatsRing
mods.description: Hypixel SkyBlock vital stats ring display

releases.notes:
- Improved mana detection for direct reads
- Add visual indicators when mana cannot be read
    - This is a known issue that would require mana estimation, but a visual cue has been added to alert when this is happening
    - The mana ring will change to gray if a mana read is not possible
    - A side effect is that a visual warning is now displayed if SkyBlock tells you the "NOT ENOUGH MANA" warning when trying to use an item, since that also hides the mana from the action bar
    - Health detection does not have this feature as it is unlikely the game will not display your health (when relevant)

**New**: Ported from a 1.8.9 ChatTriggers module into a 1.21.10 Fabric mod. The Fabric version of StatsRing depends on the [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config).
